## Consulting Industry Revenue

The revenue brought in by consulting firms in 2024 totaled 21,982 million euros, which accounts for 8.8% growth in comparison to the year before. This upward trend observed held steady another yet another year again, reaffirming the relevant contribution of consulting firms to the digital transformation within companies and government agencies, and the industry's leading role in adapting business models to a continuouslyevolvingenvironment.

## The consulting industry continues to grow (millions of euros)

## Source: AEC (Spanish Association of Consulting Firms)

This behavior reinforces the weight of the national market in the industry as a whole, all while indicating a slight adjustment in the foreign market following several yearsofsustained growth.
